text:
elaine: quick design review thread for the billing/usage dashboard — i uploaded a couple of variants in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/billing-dashboard-v2

elaine: tl;dr: goal is to make org-level spend + project breakdown obvious, surface per-token cost drivers, and keep invoice access one click away. two layout options:
- Variant A: left nav with org/project toggle, central spend chart (stacked area by project), right rail with token breakdown + invoices list
- Variant B: top toggle, card grid: spend chart (full width), token breakdown as a collapsible panel, invoices in a second tab

tony: Variant A feels faster for me — left nav keeps context when scrolling. also+1 on stacked area for multi-project customers.

vikram: accessibility nit: stacked area colors need >=4.5 contrast for text overlays. also we should avoid color-only encoding for project identity. maybe add patterns or dots for print/export?

jess: copy tweak: change "Total spend" to "Total billed (estimate)" when using unpaid credits. otherwise folks expect final invoice numbers.

elaine: good catch, jess. we'll show a small badge when credits are applied: "includes $X in credits".

zach: quick perf question — if we show per-route token breakdown (prompt vs completion vs embeddings) live, that's a lot of datapoints. can we rely on pre-aggregated hourly buckets?

vikram: yep, hourly aggregates are fine. for drilldown we can query raw events but default view should be pre-agg.

tony: UX question: org vs project default. for org admins default to org view, for devs default to project view. how do we determine role?

elaine: proposed rule: if user has >1 project in org and role = admin or billing_admin -> default org. otherwise project. include a persistent toggle so they can pin preference.

jess: invoices: users asked for CSV export of invoice line items. small example columns we should support:
```
invoice_id, date, project, usage_type, tokens, unit_price, total
```

elaine: perfect. add "downloadable CSV" to invoices list and an inline copy action.

zach: question about charts: stacked area shows negative credits as a separate series? that could create visual confusion. maybe visually separate credits as an overlay watermark or a separate negative bar at bottom.

elaine: thinking: keep spend series positive, show credits as a semi-transparent stripe behind the chart with label "credits applied". UX prefers not to invert the axis.

vikram: accessibility again: keyboard nav for the right rail widgets (token breakdown + invoices) — ensure focus order is logical and that the toggle is reachable via arrow keys.

tony: can we add a small legend that includes per-token cost rates? users ask "why did my embeddings cost spike" — legend could show current rate and recent changes (hover for history).

elaine: yep, add a small info icon with hover: "per-token rates may vary by model & quantization; see pricing page". link to /pricing and to model catalog.

billing-bot: invoice 2025-03-01 created for org:acme-inc, amount:$12,345.67 — available in Billing > Invoices.

jess: tiny copy: rename "Token breakdown" to "Usage breakdown (tokens)" — clearer for support.

elaine: action items:
- elaine: iterate figma with Variant A as baseline, incorporate accessibility color palette and credits stripe (ETA: Tue)
- zach: wire up hourly aggregates endpoint for sample org (ETA: Fri)
- vikram: write ARIA/keyboard nav checklist for right rail widgets (ETA: Wed)
- jess: update copy in figma and draft microcopy for tooltips (ETA: Tue)
- tony: confirm default-view rule with PM and update role mapping (ETA: Thu)

tony: i'm good with that plan. if no objections i'll mark Variant A as baseline for design appt next week. :+1:

elaine: no objections here. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
